title: Work orders View gives access to the work order list and detail
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View only (no Create & Edit, no Delete).
steps:
1. Log in as that user and look at the top navigation.
  2. Click Work Orders.
  3. Open a work order by clicking a row.
  4. Look for any create, edit or delete options.
expected:
Work Orders is in the top navigation.

The work order list opens.

The work order detail opens.

There is no New work order/Create button; fields are read-only; there is no delete option.
